video.title: Tap Gesture, Drag Gesture & Magnify Gesture | Day 147
video.description:
Learn to explain how a SwiftUI view reacts to touch: Tap Gesture, Drag Gesture & Magnify Gesture, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Tap Gesture - A gesture that runs code when the user taps a view.
Drag Gesture - A gesture that tracks the finger while it moves across a view.
Magnify Gesture - A gesture that tracks two fingers moving apart or together, to zoom.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 147 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Tap Gesture, Drag Gesture & Magnify Gesture | Day 147
landscape.description:
Explain Tap Gesture, Drag Gesture & Magnify Gesture in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
탭 제스처, 드래그 제스처, 매그니파이 제스처 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Tap Gesture - A gesture that runs code when the user taps a view.
한국어: 탭 제스처: 사용자가 뷰를 탭하면 코드를 실행하는 제스처

Drag Gesture - A gesture that tracks the finger while it moves across a view.
한국어: 드래그 제스처: 손가락이 뷰 위를 움직이는 동안 따라가는 제스처

Magnify Gesture - A gesture that tracks two fingers moving apart or together, to zoom.
한국어: 매그니파이 제스처: 두 손가락이 벌어지거나 모이는 것을 따라가서 확대하는 제스처

In this video, Mina and Jake make a photo viewer react to touch, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Tap Gesture, Drag Gesture and Magnify Gesture in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the photo viewer should react to touch.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Start with a Tap Gesture. It runs code when the user taps the view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used a Button first, but the photo is not a button.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Add a Tap Gesture to any view, like `.onTapGesture` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can the user move the photo with a finger?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, add a Drag Gesture. It tracks the finger while it moves across the view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And I want to zoom with two fingers.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a Magnify Gesture. It tracks two fingers moving apart or together.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I added the Drag Gesture and the Magnify Gesture, but only one works.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two gestures on one view can compete. Test them one by one, or combine them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the Tap Gesture is the easy one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Start with the Tap Gesture, then add a Drag Gesture or a Magnify Gesture.
